caption: The video captures a low-angle close-up of a sunlit concrete sidewalk, with the camera appearing fixed throughout. A horizontal expansion crack runs across the lower third, and from it a tuft of green grass blades grows upward and outward, casting thin spiky shadows onto the foreground slab. The pavement shows scattered pale specks, a few small weeds in the middle distance and along the left edge, a sharp diagonal shadow across the right side, and a bright sunlit patch near the building base. The grass tuft, its slender blade shadows, the crack line, the left-edge weeds, the right-side shadow boundary and the background sunlit patch all hold the same configuration over time, so the composition reads as still. No movement of the leaves or the shadows they throw is discernible, and nothing begins or settles during the visible portion.
